reply: I found is `p0 + p1*(1-exp(-p2*t)) + p3*t + p4*A^p5*exp(-p6*t)`, with fitted exponent A^3.01 on the A-term. Its residual still correlates with sin(t) (about -0.6), so the time dependence is probably wrong. Several other forms I tried (sin(t) terms, t·exp(-t) terms, linear-in-A terms) were no better.

best.code:
def equation(t, A, params):
    return params[0] + params[1]*(1-np.exp(-params[2]*t)) + params[6]*t + params[3]*A**params[4]*np.exp(-params[5]*t)*(1+params[7]*t)
